scripts.speaker: Edgar
scripts.text:
So are you heading to Alberta again? Let me give you the same discount and only charge 250 Zeny, just like the last time.
How's that sound?
Alrighty~!
Why are you being so nice to me?!

scripts.speaker: Edgar
scripts.text:
Um...
This isn't
enough money.
Why don't you go
get some more cash?

scripts.speaker: Edgar
scripts.text: It's just the way I am. That, and your devilish smile reminds me of my beloved blond haired son who left home years ago to become a Sailor on his own ship. Bless his soul, wherever he is.

scripts.speaker: Edgar
scripts.text: My town, Izlude, is connected to Alberta by the harbor in the West. There is so much traffic between us, I almost become an Albertian.  Hehehe~

scripts.speaker: Edgar
scripts.text: There's this guy I know pretty well, Phelix, who lives in Alberta. That guy is really stingy... He charges for everything!

scripts.speaker: Edgar
scripts.text: But he's really a nice guy and likes helping other people. He has a good heart and will give you his support if you meet his price.

scripts.speaker: Edgar
scripts.text: Lately, people in Alberta say that he is really trying to help folks and that his demand for Jellopies is just a coverup.  Well, you should take a look at what he has to offer.
Can you tell me how to get to Alberta?
End Conversation

scripts.speaker: Edgar
scripts.text: Huh? Well, you can use your feet and just walk.  But if you have money, I'd like to suggest that you take a ship.
Okay, gotcha.
But I'm sick of walking and I'm broke!

scripts.speaker: Edgar
scripts.text: Alrighty, take care~

scripts.speaker: Edgar
scripts.text:
Okay...
You don't want to walk AND you've got no cash, but you still want to go there? Oh geez...

scripts.speaker: Edgar
scripts.text: Fine fine. Me, being the captain of a ship, can afford to bring you there at a lower price. How does 250 Zeny sound?
Alrighty~!
Bah, what a rip off!!

scripts.speaker: Edgar
scripts.text:
Um...
This isn't
enough money.
Go and get
some more.

scripts.speaker: Edgar
scripts.text:
Boy oh boy,
if you think
that's a rip off...

scripts.speaker: Edgar
scripts.text:
Yeah, alright.
See you later~
